description: Find cached indicative fares and filter destinations locally by geography, climate, coast, island, elevation or terrain relief, beach or hiking traits, culture, parks, population, connectivity, and route trip-duration suitability. Use population_level=low for quieter small-city options, but note that it is a global population band, not a measure of crowds or tourism: a small city may still be busy with visitors. Other low/medium/high values are also global bands, not ranks within a country; museum_level=low means no notable museum signal, not no museums. National-park distance is to the park centre. Monthly air and water filters require month. Prices are per adult. Always link the returned search_url from a short label; never paste the raw URL.

air_temp_min.description: Minimum monthly air temperature in degrees Celsius. Requires month and excludes destinations without air-temperature data.

country.description: Two-letter destination country filter, applied locally.

currency.description: Three-letter output currency. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a currency; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

elevation_min_m.description: Minimum destination elevation above sea level in metres, applied locally. Use for mountain or high-altitude requests such as 'I want to go to the mountains' or 'хочу в горы'.

group.description: Curated destination group, applied locally. asia: cities in selected Asian countries. schengen: cities in the Schengen area. russia: domestic Russian destinations. Use the separate measured coast, monthly temperature, island, and elevation filters for those traits; do not infer unsupported themes.

island.description: When true, return tourist island destinations rather than dense urban island districts or continent-sized landmasses. Use for requests such as 'take me to an island' or 'куда на острова'.

limit.description: Maximum number of destinations to return, applied locally.

locale.description: Language locale for reference names and response text.

market.description: Two-letter country market. Set it only when the user explicitly requests a country market or local Aviasurf site; otherwise the service derives it from the departure country.

max_coast_distance_km.description: Maximum destination-city distance to the coast in kilometres, applied locally from the Aviasurf destination knowledge base.

max_national_park_distance_km.description: Maximum distance to a national park centre in kilometres.

museum_level_min.description: Minimum global museum band; low means no notable museum signal, not no museums.

origin.description: Origin city or airport IATA code.

population_level.description: Exact global population band; use low for quieter small-city options, not as a crowd or tourism measure.

sort.description: Sort by indicative price or preserve upstream popularity order.

subregion.description: UN M49 destination subregion in lowercase snake_case, applied locally.

terrain_relief_min_m.description: Minimum surrounding terrain relief in metres.

trip_duration_band.description: Route-suitability band from the destination knowledge base. Use weekend for requests such as 'weekend getaway' or 'куда на выходные'; use the other bands for an explicitly requested trip length.

water_temp_min.description: Minimum monthly water temperature in degrees Celsius. Use with month for requests such as 'where can I swim?' or 'где можно купаться'; destinations without water data are excluded.

name: cheapest_destinations
title: Discover indicative destination prices
